about.label: Ilmara Foundation began as a conversation among university studen
about.value: Ilmara Foundation began as a conversation among university students who kept coming back to the same problem: in Pakistan, a child's entire future can hinge on whether their family can afford a single year of school fees, a uniform, or a set of books. That felt solvable, at a small scale, if the right people were willing to fund it and stay accountable for it.

about.label: Fund specific children. Report specific outcomes.
about.value: Fund specific children. Report specific outcomes.

about.label: We don't collect money for a general cause and hope it helps. Eve
about.value: We don't collect money for a general cause and hope it helps. Every donation is tied to a named intervention — a specific child, a specific school, a specific year — identified through a trusted local contact on the ground in Pakistan.

about.label: We track what that support actually produces: enrollment, attenda
about.value: We track what that support actually produces: enrollment, attendance, and how the child is doing in school, and we share that back with the people who funded it.

about.label: Transparency isn't a feature, it's the whole point
about.value: Transparency isn't a feature, it's the whole point

about.label: Ilmara is a student-led initiative built on direct relationships
about.value: Ilmara is a student-led initiative built on direct relationships and honest reporting. Our Washington State nonprofit registration application is pending. Donations will open after our banking and payment setup is ready.

projects.label: Named in memory of Naseem, my grandmother — who spent her life ma
projects.value: Named in memory of Naseem, my grandmother — who spent her life making sure the people around her had what they needed, and who believed a child's future shouldn't depend on what their family could afford.

projects.label: Our founding initiative sponsors a group of children beginning fi
projects.value: Our founding initiative sponsors a group of children beginning first grade in Pakistan, covering everything needed to keep them in school for the year: tuition, a uniform, and books and stationery.

projects.label: We're partnering directly with a trusted local contact to choose
projects.value: We're partnering directly with a trusted local contact to choose the school and the children, so every donation traces back to a real seat in a real classroom — not a general fund.

projects.label: Our team updates these allocations in USD, including education an
projects.value: Our team updates these allocations in USD, including education and operating costs. The remaining balance is recorded donations minus allocations.

projects.label: Once a child is enrolled, we'll follow their year closely — atten
projects.value: Once a child is enrolled, we'll follow their year closely — attendance, coursework, and how they're settling in — and pass that along to supporters every few months, in plain terms, alongside how funds were used.

privacy.label: Launch-stage policy. Donation processing is not yet enabled.
privacy.value: Donations are completed on LaunchGood. This website collects email subscriptions, not payment details.

privacy.label: If you sign up for launch news, we store your email address, cons
privacy.value: When you continue to LaunchGood, we store your email address, consent time and subscription status for scholarship impact updates. The coming-soon form does not submit an email until a fundraiser link is configured. Launch-news subscriptions are recorded separately. Short-lived hashed request identifiers limit automated abuse.

privacy.label: When donations open, your name, email, campaign, amount, currency
privacy.value: LaunchGood handles donation and payment details under its own policies. Entering your email on Ilmara does not confirm a donation, and your email is not added to the redirect URL. Fundraising totals on this website are not automatically synchronized with LaunchGood.

privacy.label: Fundraising emails require a separate opt-in. Donation confirmati
privacy.value: Submitting the LaunchGood email form subscribes you to scholarship impact updates only. You can unsubscribe through a link in those emails or contact aayan@ilmara.org. Launch and fundraising emails have a separate signup.

privacy.label: Access to donor records is restricted to authorized administrator
privacy.value: Access to donor records is restricted to authorized administrators. Contact aayan@ilmara.org to request access, correction or deletion, or to withdraw consent. Records needed for payment reconciliation may need to be retained.

privacy.label: Public reports should not identify sponsored children or disclose
privacy.value: Public reports should not identify sponsored children or disclose sensitive details. Names, photos and other identifying material require appropriate guardian and school permissions before publication.

unsubscribe.label: You can stop fundraising emails while continuing to receive neces
unsubscribe.value: Use the link in your email to stop future subscription emails.
